newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Jugooceanija gets 32.5 mln franc credit - agency.
newsitem.headline: Jugooceanija gets 32.5 mln franc credit - agency.

text.p: The Yugoslav shipper Jugooceanija of Kotor, Montenegro, has been granted a credit of 32.5 million French francs in France, the Yugoslav state news agency Tanjug reported Friday evening.

"The credit, available from September 2, will be used to repair and launch Jugooceanija's vessels anchored in various ports in the world," Tanjug quotes Jugooceanija director Milivoje Jaukovic as saying.

The "extremely favourable" credit was secured with the help of a ship owner from Monaco, a long-standing partner of the Kotor shipping company, Tanjug said. It gave no other details. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 224305
